scope: Participant/team-specific Fortnite competitive qualification outcomes, active routes and conditional next actions for EU/global events relevant to France
source_of_truth: Official Fortnite Competitive results/standings and explicitly authorized organizer results only.

principles.separate_from_global_lifecycle: A qualifier can be globally complete while a participant outcome remains UNKNOWN/PENDING until participant-specific evidence is sufficient.
principles.route_aware: Outcomes are scoped to a qualification route/phase. Failing one route does not mean event elimination when another official route remains.
principles.no_absence_inference: Absence from one result page, final lobby, article or crawl never proves elimination.
principles.stable_participant_id: A tracked player/team keeps one participant_id; display-name changes become aliases.
principles.team_result_scope: DUO/TRIO/SQUAD outcomes belong to the exact official roster identity; never transfer them to a different roster containing one same player.
principles.result_finality: Provisional standings may update rank/points and PENDING state, but irreversible qualification/elimination requires final-enough official evidence.
principles.conditional_final_bridge: Final play reminders are activated only when the participant is officially qualified to that target and the final has usable future timing.

resolution_rules.ADVANCED: Officially progressed to another non-final phase/round. This is not yet QUALIFIED to the tracked final target.
resolution_rules.QUALIFIED: Requires explicit official qualified result/list or final official standings plus a verified advancement rule unambiguously placing the participant in the target.
resolution_rules.ELIMINATED_PATH: One route or attempt is conclusively failed, but at least one other official route to the same target may remain available.
resolution_rules.ELIMINATED_EVENT: Requires final official evidence that the participant failed all applicable official routes to the tracked target; invalid if any active route remains.
resolution_rules.PENDING: Participant played/entered but advancement cannot yet be safely determined, including provisional standings/review/tiebreak situations.
resolution_rules.ACTIVE: Participant is still eligible/in progress on the route before a final outcome is known.
resolution_rules.UNKNOWN: Default when participant-specific evidence is insufficient.

route_rules.lcq_guard: Never produce ELIMINATED_EVENT while a sourced LCQ/secondary route remains active and the participant remains eligible.
route_rules.unknown_future_route: Do not keep a participant artificially alive because a historical circuit usually had an LCQ; the route must be officially present.

result_policy.provisional: PROVISIONAL can update rank/points and state PENDING/ACTIVE only. It cannot permanently set ELIMINATED_EVENT unless Epic explicitly states a final disqualification/withdrawal.
result_policy.final_derived: OFFICIAL_STANDINGS_DERIVED requires final official standings and a verified qualification rule whose slots/criteria make the conclusion unambiguous.
result_policy.correction: A corrected official result creates a new outcome with result_finality CORRECTED_FINAL and supersedes_outcome_id. Never mutate the old outcome in place.
result_policy.result_fingerprint: Hash/logical fingerprint should include source result identity + rank/points + qualification rule/version + route/target. Identical result never re-notifies.

rules: If QUALIFIED and final timing is official/future, next_action becomes PLAY_FINAL when participation is relevant.
If primary route failed but official LCQ remains active, next_action can become PLAY_LCQ rather than elimination.
If qualifier ended and result finality is not FINAL_OFFICIAL/CORRECTED_FINAL, next_action is WAIT_RESULT.
Past or expired actions are never returned as next_action.
secondary_actions may retain WATCH_FINAL/ATTEND_FINAL independently of play qualification.

finale_bridge.on_qualified: Resolve qualification_target, suppress unused alternative qualifier reminders, and arm only future participant-specific final reminders. Do not recreate or re-UID the global final VEVENT.
finale_bridge.on_eliminated_path: Suppress reminders for that route only; recalculate next_action from remaining official routes.
finale_bridge.on_eliminated_event: Invalidate participant PLAY/REGISTER/CHECK_IN downstream reminders; preserve global WATCH/ATTEND reminders.
finale_bridge.on_pending: Do not arm final PLAY reminders yet; WAIT_RESULT may be the next action.
finale_bridge.on_correction: Recalculate route states, next_action and future reminders from the corrected final outcome; preserve history.

notify: ELIMINATED_PATH when it changes next action to a sourced LCQ/other route
official correction changing qualification state or next final action
silent: route metadata enrichment without action impact
notification_policy.dedupe_key: participant_id + competition_id + phase_id + route_id-or-null + state + qualification_target + result_fingerprint
